visualCharacteristics: Full-width hero carousel with 5 promotional slides. Each slide has a background image, headline/description text overlay, and a CTA link.
contentPattern: Each row is one slide. Column 1: background image. Column 2: headline, description text, and CTA link.
usage: Use for full-width hero banners at the top of landing pages with rotating promotional content.
reuseGuidance: Each slide row should have an image in the first cell and text content with an optional CTA link in the second cell.
